text: • The LCH managers will increase their efforts to inform the public about the purposes of both the demolition program and the REVIVAL program for revitalizing vacant Cityowned lots. Since neither of these programs is well known to the public, there are occasional misunderstandings about their purposes and their relation to other community development programs. To remedy this situation, LCH managers will post notices of explanation at the vacant lot and prepare press releases for the city and community newspapers.
